summary: Admit the official bounded single-order 5Post PDF label read through the reviewed runtime.

impacts.evidence: The existing label route resolves the account in authenticated tenant scope before invoking the reader.
Only an opaque digest reference crosses the host boundary; PDF bytes, JWT and provider payload remain inside transport.
The existing generic label route now admits 5Post through the registry.
No event envelope or event payload changes.
The existing fivepost LogisticsLabelReader is composed into the builtin runtime.
Existing label operation and artifact-reference boundaries are sufficient.
Fixed-host HTTPS, callback-scoped secret, UUID path validation, response bounds and PDF signature checks remain mandatory.
The operation is a bounded document read and does not change approval policy.
No privileged mutation or audit schema change is introduced.
One provider order is requested and not-ready responses remain retryable errors without duplicate connector writes.
The transport uses only the official 5Post API host and does not admit callbacks.
Shared HTTP timeout and response-size handling cover the bounded PDF response.
Removing the fivepost registry branch or support capability immediately closes label reads.
Deterministic PDF MIME/signature tests verify the official route and artifact boundary.
